Explore how we can help drive your chip design to the next level.

Unlock new levels of innovation and productivity with Synopsys’ advanced Digital Design Implementation solutions, powered by AI. Our intelligent tools are designed to help you meet stringent performance, power, and area (PPA) objectives, while seamlessly aligning with manufacturing requirements and quality standards.

With Synopsys AI-driven solutions, digital design engineers can automate complex workflows, streamline repetitive tasks, and accelerate decision-making. Harnessing the power of data from previous projects, our AI technology provides actionable insights—such as optimized floorplans, early identification of timing challenges, and recommendations to enhance power efficiency. AI-enabled verification tools further boost design confidence by rapidly detecting potential errors, helping you minimize risk and reduce costly iterations.

By integrating AI throughout the digital design process, you can achieve faster turnaround times, consistently high-quality results, and greater opportunity for breakthrough innovation. Empower your team to push the boundaries of what’s possible with Synopsys AI-powered design solutions.

Analog design is inherently challenging due to its sensitivity to process variations, the complexity of device interactions, and the need for precision across a wide range of operating conditions. Synopsys Award Winning ASO.ai™ revolutionizes analog and mixed-signal design and verification by harnessing the power of AI-driven automation, enabling engineering teams to dramatically accelerate workflows that have traditionally required extensive manual effort.

Accelerate SoC verification and drive exceptional quality with Synopsys’ AI-powered verification solutions. Our intelligent verification platform empowers engineers to efficiently meet functional, performance, and quality targets by automating complex tasks and surfacing issues earlier in the verification process.

With Synopsys AI-driven technology, you can analyze vast simulation and test datasets to uncover targeted test scenarios, anticipate functional risks, and receive data-informed recommendations to boost coverage and verification efficiency. Advanced AI-powered debug tools further streamline bug detection and root-cause analysis, minimizing the likelihood of costly late-stage changes and rework.

By integrating Synopsys’ AI-powered verification solutions into your flow, your team can realize faster verification cycles, deeper coverage, improved quality of results, and accelerated time-to-market—enabling you to deliver innovation with confidence.

Tackle the complexity of modern system design with confidence using Synopsys’ AI-powered solutions. System engineers are challenged to architect, integrate, and manage advanced systems that seamlessly blend hardware and software, all while meeting demanding schedules and stringent requirements for performance, security, and scalability.

Synopsys delivers a unified suite of intelligent tools that support the entire journey from silicon to complete systems. Our AI-powered technologies address the unique challenges of 3D ICs and Multiphysics integration—enabling engineers to accelerate design cycles, optimize system architectures, and ensure robust interoperability.

With Synopsys 3DSO.ai integrated into the 3DIC Compiler platform, system engineers can efficiently explore, implement, and sign off on complex multi-die designs. By leveraging AI-powered insights and automation, you can boost productivity, achieve exceptional system performance, and deliver high-quality results—empowering your team to push the boundaries of next-generation electronic systems.

AI is revolutionizing the way DFT engineers approach test challenges. Synopsys AI-driven TestMAX solutions bring a new level of intelligence and automation to the DFT process, empowering engineers to achieve higher quality results, faster and more efficiently than ever before. With TSO.ai™, the industry’s first autonomous AI application for semiconductor test, engineers can rapidly optimize pattern counts, fine-tune ATPG parameters, and accelerate turnaround times—driving down costs and reducing manual intervention.

TestMAX ATPG harnesses the power of AI to continuously learn from design data, streamlining pattern generation and diagnosis for optimal test coverage and efficiency. Meanwhile, TestMAX DFT delivers automation from RTL to silicon, ensuring robust testability is built in at every stage.

By integrating advanced AI across the TestMAX family, DFT engineers can confidently keep pace with growing design complexity, achieve ambitious quality and schedule goals, and deliver comprehensive, cost-effective test solutions for today’s most advanced SoCs.

AI is transforming semiconductor manufacturing by enabling process and yield engineers to achieve unprecedented levels of efficiency, quality, and productivity. Synopsys’ AI-powered manufacturing analytics solutions deliver real-time insights and intelligent automation, empowering engineers to proactively optimize yield and maintain the highest standards of production.

With advanced capabilities such as real-time equipment monitoring, dynamic fault detection, and predictive analytics, engineers can swiftly identify process deviations, uncover root causes, and implement corrective actions—often before issues can impact manufacturing outcomes. Solutions like eFDC for equipment fault detection and classification, eDataLyzer for comprehensive root cause analysis, and eR2R for automated recipe optimization drive a transition from reactive problem-solving to proactive process control.

Integrated chamber matching and recipe management tools further enhance consistency and minimize variability across equipment fleets, supporting robust and reliable manufacturing processes. By harnessing AI-driven insights and automation, Synopsys empowers process and yield engineers to streamline operations, accelerate decision-making, and confidently meet the complex demands of high-volume semiconductor production.
